title: Manager, Design Engineering - Optical
description:

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.
Zayo is seeking a Manager, Design Engineering - Optical to lead a team of Optical Design Engineers that are responsible for designing, capital allocation, link engineering, project managing, and implementing new optical services on DWDM network.

The Manager, Design Engineering - Optical will effectively communicate with internal order management personnel and various internal teams on the progress of the team’s respective projects. In addition, the Manager, Design Engineering - Optical will be responsible for the team meeting and exceeding key performance targets monthly, quarterly and annually.

The Manager, Design Engineering - Optical requires high level knowledge of DWDM optical networks, signal flow, optical power requirements, electrical power requirements, network build, augment, and groom designs. The position is a leadership role responsible for their team's success.

• Performs other related duties or projects as assigned by management.

• Participates in the development and implementation of engineering standards and procedures.

• Implement plans for cross-training team members to learn additional duties.

• Acts as a reference for training; communicate training needs to the Management.

• Participates in operations-related projects, as needed.

• Works with Project Managers and Design and Implementation Engineers when issues arise during capacity projects.

• Designs DWDM network per Network Architectures standards and future growth of our network and customer base. Implements circuit designs for the core of the network as needed.

• Provides direction in the circuit design function of the Engineering Department for orders with transport and facilities required to meet identified circuit requirements.

• Reviews capacity request for correctness and clarifies any design related items back to the responsible departments.

description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon exists to protect life. Our technologies - from TASER devices to body worn cameras to AI-powered software - are reshaping how law enforcement operates and how agencies keep communities safe. As Director of Federal Policy, you will be the strategic quarterback at the center of Axon's federal engagement: mapping our assets, aligning our engagements, and driving a coordinated approach that positions Axon as the trusted technology partner for the agencies that matter most.

This isn't a traditional lobbying role. We're looking for someone who brings their own strategic instincts, knows how to connect dots across a complex organization, and has a deep understanding of federal law enforcement culture, Congressional stakeholders, and how technology gets adopted. You'll sit inside the legal organization, closely embed with the business, and engage frequently with Axon's executive team in order to serve as Axon's most important federal convener. This is an individual contributor role: you will lead through expertise, relationships, and influence rather than direct reports.

What You’ll Do

• Drive federal strategy. Develop and own a multi-year federal government affairs strategy that advances Axon's priorities across the executive branch and relevant Congressional committees in order to support our top policy issues. Tie the work to Axon's mission and business results.

• Take stock and map the field. Conduct a systematic audit of Axon's federal relationships - internal champions, external advisors, agency allies, Hill contacts, and third-party partners - and build a living picture of our assets and gaps.

• Quarterback policy engagement. Coordinate across Axon's legal, communications, product, sales and executive teams to ensure our efforts are unified, strategic, and non-duplicative. You are the connective tissue.

• Cultivate and leverage relationships. Build and maintain a high-quality network of relationships with senior officials, Congressional staff, and relevant organizations. Know who matters and where their interests overlap with Axon’s mission and products. 

• Navigate the law enforcement landscape. Bring genuine fluency in how law enforcement adopts technology and how policy from the hill and the white house can help support the law enforcement community. 

• Win Right. Ensure all federal engagement meets the highest ethical and compliance standards.

• Manage external consultants and advisors. Direct and coordinate a network of outside government affairs firms, ensuring alignment and accountability across all federal engagement activities.

• Monitor and analyze the policy environment. Track legislative, regulatory, and executive branch developments relevant to Axon's business. Translate what's happening in Washington into clear, actionable intelligence for internal decision-makers.

• Represent Axon externally. Serve as a credible, compelling voice for Axon at federal conferences, industry forums, and stakeholder meetings - clearly articulating our mission, our technology, and our value to the agencies we serve.

• Connect policy to outcomes. Tie federal engagement to Axon's mission and business results, such as policy wins and agency adoption, and report progress to leadership.

title: Global AML Manager
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Regulatory & Compliance team at Airwallex is a global, collaborative function responsible for helping the company grow safely and sustainably. We provide trusted guidance across the business, strengthen our regulatory framework, and promote a culture of compliance, sound risk management, and ethical conduct.

The Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team is a strategically important second-line function operating under a clear three lines of defense model, with responsibility for Airwallex’s global anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CTF) and sanctions frameworks. As Airwallex expands into new markets and deepens its engagement with regulators and financial institution partners, the team helps manage complex financial crime risks across a growing global business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

This role offers an opportunity to join a high-impact team working to help Airwallex manage global money laundering and terrorist financing risks. You will translate regulatory expectations and financial crime risks into practical, risk-based policies, controls, and guidance that support safe and sustainable growth. You will work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, Risk, Engineering, and regional compliance teams across a global payments business.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Support the development, implementation and ongoing maintenance of Airwallex’s Global AML/CTF Policy Framework, including articulation of global minimum standards,across the first and second lines of defense, partnering with regional teams on appropriate regional and local adaptations.

- Develop, implement, and advise on risk-based AML/CTF processes and controls covering customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, beneficial ownership, ongoing monitoring, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity escalation, and higher-risk customer management.

- Monitor global AML/CTF regulatory developments, enforcement trends, and industry practices, assess their impact on Airwallex, and support updates to policies, procedures, controls, and implementation plans.

- Advisory support for the review and investigation of escalated customers, accounts, and transactions involving potential money laundering, terrorist financing, or other financial crime concerns to provide interpretative guidance of policy requirements.

- Partner with the Risk Assessment, Product, Data, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance Technology teams to identify emerging risks, evaluate control effectiveness, and translate AML/CTF requirements into effective onboarding, monitoring, screening, payment, and case-management workflows.

- Support regulatory examinations, partner bank inquiries, and audits; prepare governance materials, metrics, risk indicators, and training; and contribute to due diligence, remediation, and continuous improvement projects that strengthen the global AML/CTF program.

- Maintain central program registers and governance of action items

title: Assistant Financial Controller
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

ASSISTANT FINANCIAL CONTROLLER

Location: Lisbon, Portugal

YOUR MISSION

As an Assistnat Financial Controller at Teya, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity and reliability of our financial reporting while supporting the wider Finance function and partnering with teams across the business. You will help strengthen financial controls, improve reporting processes and ensure that our financial operations remain efficient, scalable and compliant with applicable requirements.

You will take ownership of key financial control activities, including month-end and year-end closing, account reconciliations, financial reporting and audit preparation. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external providers, you will ensure financial records are accurate, discrepancies are investigated and resolved, and reporting deadlines are consistently met.

Beyond core financial control responsibilities, you will support the business in understanding financial performance, identifying key drivers and uncovering opportunities to improve processes. You will bring a structured, analytical approach to problem-solving, helping implement robust financial procedures and promote continuous improvement across Finance Operations.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing, fast-paced business, working collaboratively across teams to strengthen financial governance, support compliance and build high-quality, scalable finance processes at Teya.

- Support the Finance function and partner with teams across the business to assess financial performance, identify key business drivers and improve financial processes and controls.

- Coordinate and support month-end and year-end closing activities, ensuring financial records are complete, accurate and delivered within reporting deadlines.

- Assist in preparing monthly financial reports and annual financial statements, maintaining high standards of accuracy and consistency.

- Perform and review account reconciliations to ensure the integrity of financial records, investigate variances and resolve discrepancies against expected balances and budget assumptions.

- Monitor financial data and accounting records, identifying potential errors, inconsistencies or control weaknesses and working with relevant stakeholders to implement corrective actions.

- Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations and supporting financial analyses, ensuring documentation is accurate, complete and readily available.

- Coordinate the preparation of documentation and supporting evidence for external audits, working closely with auditors and internal teams to address requests efficiently.

- Maintain accurate financial records and documentation, ensuring compliance with internal policies, accounting principles and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Work closely with internal stakeholders to gather, validate and consolidate financial information for reporting, analysis and decision-making.

.

title: Clinical Expert, Care Team Operations
description:
About Us
Thesis is building the AI-powered care team platform for infinitely scalable clinical capacity. We radically increase access and improve quality of care by combining AI agents with clinical experts to take on high-impact clinical operations and care management activities for healthcare organizations.
We’re based in NYC, are growing rapidly, and are backed by $60 million in funding from Oak HC/FT, CRV, Black Opal Ventures, and experienced C-level healthtech angel investors.
About the role
We are looking for a passionate and versatile nurse to join Thesis as a foundational member of our clinical operations team. This is a broad-scope “utility player” role for a clinician who is equally comfortable performing hands-on care management work, collaborating with product and engineering teams to refine automated technology workflows, and coaching staff on quality and clinical standards. You will work across Thesis’s full portfolio of care team agents, supporting everything from chronic condition management and care gap outreach to complex prior authorizations and clinical documentation improvement. In this role, you will serve as an expert-in-the-loop: the clinical voice that ensures we deliver safe, high-quality care at scale.
Responsibilities:

•
Deliver high-impact clinical work : Perform care management outreach, chronic condition follow-ups, care gap closure, and other clinical activities powered by Thesis’s AI platform.

•
Support complex clinical operations workflows : Review prior authorizations, appeals, and other clinical-administrative tasks that require human clinical judgment.

•
Provide quality oversight : Conduct quality audits of clinical operations activities, identify trends in errors or gaps, and develop remediation plans. Maintain and evolve quality scorecards and clinical rubrics.

•
Develop clinical content and coach staff : Build the clinical protocols, scripts, and decision-support content that power Thesis AI agents, and onboard and train clinical team members on Thesis’s platform, workflows, and quality standards.

•
Partner with product and engineering : Serve as a clinical subject matter expert, participating in workflow design sessions, testing new agent capabilities, identifying edge cases, and providing feedback.

We expect you to have:

•
Active clinical licensure : Current RN or equivalent clinical license in good standing. Multi-state or Compact licensure is a plus.

•
Strong clinical experience : 2-5 years spanning direct patient care and virtual or telephonic care delivery, with meaningful exposure to care management, utilization management, prior authorization, or population health workflows.

•
Healthtech experience : Prior experience in a healthtech company, venture-backed startup, health plan, or technology-enabled clinical services organization.

•
Quality mindset and entrepreneurial approach : You are detail-oriented, comfortable delivering constructive feedback, and energized by early-stage environments where you’re creating processes from the ground up.

•
Location : This is a remote role based in the continental US.

Target compensation for this role is $80-$120k+, plus a generous benefits package. Compensation within this range will depend on experience, licensure level, and scope of responsibilities.
Please note: This role is staffed through our employment partner. The third party company will be your employer of record (payroll, benefits, HR), while you'll work directly with the Thesis Care team on daily responsibilities.
Thesis Care is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Senior Lithography Application Engineer

Our machines enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to increase the production yields, and thus, functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics.
Founded in 2016, we bring together the most creative minds (approx. 320 employees) in science and technology and develop a one-of-a-kind, revolutionary high throughput Scanning Probe Microscopy system.
About the job
Senior application engineer in Lithography and Optical Imaging with a strong background in lithography, EUV, and scanner performance optimization. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in optical imaging and lithography physics to advance our metrology and process control solutions.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

You will join Everpure’s Datastore team to design, develop, and validate embedded firmware for our DirectFlash™ modules. In this role, you will work across firmware and hardware boundaries to build reliable, high-performance storage solutions, while also developing virtual platforms and tooling that accelerate development, debugging, and validation. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional engineering teams to solve complex system-level problems and help deliver innovative products to market.  Comment end   

What You Will Be Doing

Everpure is seeking a full-time Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our device firmware team. You will be responsible for developing high-fidelity virtual platforms that abstract complex hardware behaviors to accelerate SSD firmware development. In this role, you will be responsible for:

• Developing and maintaining comprehensive firmware simulation environments (e.g., QEMU) to enable shift-left testing, reducing dependency on physical hardware and accelerating time-to-market.

• Creating accurate, high-fidelity hardware models to abstract controller logic, communication interfaces (PCIe, NVMe), and NAND media behaviors within Pure Storage’s DirectFlash™ SSD Modules.

• Designing and implementing instrumentation tools to profile performance and analyze failures within the simulated environment.

• Automating CI/CD pipelines to seamlessly integrate simulation and virtual platforms into our firmware release and validation processes.

• Partnering closely with ASIC vendors to validate firmware behaviors against RTL and digital logic designs before physical silicon is available.

• 5+ years of experience building and scaling complex embedded, firmware, or hardware-software systems.

• Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ (object oriented design and C++ 11 and onwards) and strong Python skills for both firmware and modeling development.

• Deep understanding of firmware-hardware interaction, including the ability to translate complex schematics and data sheets into abstract software models.

• Solid Linux (kernel, bootloaders) understanding and ability to root‑cause across HW/FW boundaries.

• Strong knowledge of high-performance storage protocols such as PCIe and NVMe.

• Experience with embedded software development, RTOS and SoC and hardware bring-up.

• Good verbal communication & collaboration skills.

• Must be willing and able to work onsite in an open office and team environment.

description:

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
As an FDSE your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. 
 
Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place - with the best colleagues - to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

title: Account Executive
description:

FirstPrinciples is building AI to accelerate scientific discovery. Our core product is the Theo Platform, a research environment built to help researchers iterate faster, validate rigorously, and reach verified results they can trust.

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists:

We’re building products to accelerate progress in physics - but that only matters if the right researchers discover them, understand how they work, and make the decision to adopt them. Besides building the technology, the challenge is earning the trust of researchers and institutions, and translating it into active usage and commercial relationships.

This role exists to lead that journey. You’ll work across the full sales lifecycle: from identifying and reaching out to researchers and organizations, to discovery, demos, evaluations, and close. Your impact will directly shape who we serve, how we bring the product to market, and how quickly we build a repeatable path to adoption and revenue.

- Build lightweight systems for outreach, qualification, account planning, CRM management, follow-up, and forecasting that can scale with the organization

- Own clear pipeline, conversion, and revenue goals while helping define our early sales playbook

Who You Are:

- Exceptionally curious and analytical, with the ability to rapidly develop fluency in unfamiliar technical and scientific domains

- High agency and learning velocity; you’re comfortable being dropped into a complex topic, figuring it out quickly, and operating without an established playbook

- Able to form strong, testable points of view from incomplete information, grounded in first-principles reasoning rather than defaulting to established frameworks

- Commercially minded and excited by turning complex technology into customer relationships, adoption, and revenue

We run Hasbro's brands as businesses. Six global categories, each with a named owner, a number and the authority to go after it. We decide what gets made, what gets funded and what gets stopped, and we answer for the result.

We are builders and operators in equal measure. The work spans the consumer insight that starts a line, the product and pricing decisions that shape its margin, and the commercial execution that puts it in someone's hands. The brands are iconic. The job is to make them grow.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Vice President, Board Games to own the global Board Games P&L, a portfolio built on some of the most recognized play experiences in the world, including Monopoly, Jenga, Connect Four, The Game of Life, Clue and Twister. You will lead a team of twelve and report to the SVP, Global Brands.

This role owns Hasbro's physical board game and tabletop portfolio. It is distinct from our digital, video game and trading card businesses, which sit elsewhere in the company, though you will partner with them where a brand lives in more than one place.

This role is based in Boston, Massachusetts, and is onsite three days a week, Tuesday through Thursday. Expect to travel approximately 25% of the time.

This is a general management role. You own the revenue, the margin and the operating profit, and you hold the authority to allocate the investment behind them. Product and North America commercial report to you directly, and every other function partners with you. Finance is your copilot: they bring the expertise, the tools and the information, and the decision stays with you.

In your first year we would expect you to land a credible multi-year plan for the portfolio, make explicit calls on which brands to grow and which to run for profit, and show measurable progress on both the top line and the margin. The mandate is to grow a portfolio of category-defining brands while making it meaningfully more profitable.

A day in the life:

• Own the global Board Games P&L end to end. Carry the revenue, variable margin and operating profit targets, and answer for the return on every dollar you deploy.

• Set the multi-year strategy for the portfolio, making explicit choices about which brands to grow, which to run for profit and which to stop funding.

• Read the global landscape and adjust the plan for it, including macroeconomic conditions, trade and tariff policy, input costs, retail consolidation and shifts in consumer spending across regions.

• Lead with consumer insight, and convert it. Turn what you learn about players and shoppers into specific product, pricing, channel and new business opportunities rather than into research that sits on a shelf.

• Allocate and spend the investment across marketing, tooling, retail activation and A&P, and hold the line on what earns the next dollar.

• Drive product excellence, including the consumer price point each item is designed for and the cost structure that supports it.

title: Cards Experience Guide

title: Co-Founder & CEO — AI-Native Accounting Firm
description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadFieldstone, an AI-native accounting firm. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Fieldstoneis an accounting firm built from a blank page around an agent fleet. Agents run bookkeeping, reconciliation, workpapers, and first-pass tax returns continuously, and every human in the firm sits in a reviewer seat: applying judgment, signing off, and owning the client relationship. You bring your client relationships and your craft. A FutureSight technical co-founder works alongside you inside the practice, automating the work as you do it, so the product is built from real engagements from day one.
Market Context
US accounting services is a $150B industry, with an estimated $29B serviceable market across 900K US and Canadian businesses in the $1-20M revenue band. Demand is growing while supply collapses: over 300,000 accountants have left the profession since 2020, CPA exam candidates are down more than 30% over the past decade, and roughly 75% of active CPAs are retirement-eligible. Regional firms are turning away mid-market clients because they no longer have the capacity to serve them. That is Fieldstone's entry point.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

• Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

• Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and agent development, with potential for follow-on funding

• A technical co-founder embedded in your practice from day one, building the agent fleet around your workflow

• Venture building resources, including design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across fintech and early-stage capital markets

• A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight 's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

• Clients: Bring over your founding client base and win new mid-market clients through your network

• Practice: Own quality of work, review standards, and every client relationship as the firm's lead CPA

• Product: Work side by side with the technical co-founder, turning your daily workflow into agents and your review corrections into accuracy gains

• Licensing: Lead firm registration and CPA licensing across US states

• Capital: Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight 's network and traction

• Team: Hire reviewer CPAs and establish the cultural foundation of the firm

Co-Founder Profile

• Licensed US CPA with partner or senior manager experience at an accounting firm

• An established book of client relationships you can bring into a new firm

• Hands-on experimentation with AI tools in your own practice, and conviction that the firm model needs to change

• Strong business development track record, winning and retaining clients on the strength of your work

• Product mindset, with the curiosity to break down your own workflow and shape how it gets automated

• Ability to build an investor narrative and close capital with FutureSight 's support

• Experience in bookkeeping, tax, and advisory for 1M-20M businesses

What We Do
At Terabase Energy , we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar.  To fully unlock the potential of this opportunity, Terabase is developing an interconnected software and construction automation platform.  We work alongside project developers, owners, and engineering & construction firms to support the design, optimization, and construction of huge solar projects around the world. Position Overview
The Sr. Controls Engineer - OT SCADA Projects leads the design, configuration, commissioning, and support of plant control systems for utility-scale solar, storage, and hybrid renewable energy projects. This engineer works with minimal oversight, applies expert knowledge of grid functionality and Utility/ISO standards, mentors junior engineers, and contributes to product standards. Approximately 80% of this role is project execution, while up to 20% is continuous improvement and product development.
Responsibilities
Project Execution & Technical Delivery (~80%)

• Produce project deliverables: System Architecture Diagrams, Control Narratives, Logic Diagrams, commissioning documents, and operator manuals

Product & Process Improvement (~20%)

• Contribute to new feature development and bug fixes in collaboration with the Product Engineering team

• Review documentation prepared by junior controls engineers (technical and non-technical)

• Lead the Continuous Improvement and Lessons Learned program, feed field insights back into product standards and templates

• Coach junior engineers through FAT preparation and customer-facing presentation

Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration

• Serve as primary controls technical contact for EPCs, asset owners, and grid operators through project execution, FAT, and commissioning

• Lead FATs as formal presentations; communicate to non-technical audiences with supporting materials prepared in advance

• Flag technical risks and schedule pressures to project management team with context and proposed solutions

• Maintain Jira tickets daily with thorough detail; enforce Jira best practices with junior engineers

Expectations & Success Indicators

• Deliver high-quality work independently across multiple concurrent projects with ownership and urgency

• Leverage standardized platforms and tools to work efficiently

• Ensure 100% adherence to Terabase quality processes; enforce standards with junior engineers

• Mentor junior controls engineers through technical guidance, code review, and FAT coaching

• Project deliverables completed on time, within scope, and meeting Utility/ISO regulato

title: Power Platform Technical Lead
description:
A significant share of the work in this role is matching the exact behavior of real, already-deployed legacy and Power Platform systems from their own source exports, not just building new features from a blank slate. This role therefore calls for both strong Power Platform delivery expertise and a reverse-engineering mindset.
Responsibilities

• Design and build Dataverse schemas, Power Automate flows, security roles, and generative code pages for Power Platform modernization workstreams.

• Decode and faithfully replicate the behavior of existing, already-deployed systems by reading their exported source directly, not just working from requirements documents.

• Go beyond no-code and low-code tooling when needed by authoring raw Dataverse Web API and metadata calls, debugging flows through run history and API tooling, and diagnosing undocumented platform behavior through direct testing.

• Own the technical integrity of cross-environment integrations, JIT identity provisioning, service-account patterns, and the security model, including roles and privilege scoping.

• Identify and clearly document design divergences from source systems, distinguishing verified behavior, new functionality, accepted simplifications, and assumptions.

• Mentor and direct supporting developers, review flow and schema designs for correctness and maintainability, and provide hands-on coding guidance.

• Maintain a living requirements-traceability record mapping what is built against the authoritative requirement source.

Requirements
Required Skills and Experience
Screen for concrete, demonstrable experience in each area below. 5+ years of Power Platform experience alone is not a sufficient filter for this role.

title: Junior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe waar wij naar op zoek zijn?
Volg jij alle nieuwe features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers hot zijn op dit moment? Ben je vloeiend in zowel Nederlands als Engels? Dan willen wij graag met jou praten!

Over WPP Media
WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertising conglomeraat. Wij ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media vinden diverse centrale activiteiten plaats, zoals StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamisch, jong en ambitieus bedrijf met duizenden (Young) Professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam en Eindhoven, waar honderden collega's werken voor topklanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr.Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend 180 graden uitzicht over de stad en de Amstel. Onze werksfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de 9e verdieping.

Wat ga je doen?
Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau dat verantwoordelijk is voor Influencer Marketing campagnes die we op grote (internationale) schaal uitzetten.

Dit betekent dat je gaat werken met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

Passie voor influencer marketing : je leeft en ademt social media, bekijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie, en denkt in Instagram Stories.

Creativiteit en coördinatie: je bent creatief maar werkt ook gestructureerd en gecoördineerd. Je hebt een goed begrip van de werking en innovaties van platformen zoals Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok en Snapchat.

Uitvoerend talent: als Junior Influencer Marketing Specialist maak je deel uit van het StudioM Influencer Marketing team en zorg je ervoor dat campagnes vlekkeloos worden uitgevoerd. Je bent hands-on en zorgt ervoor dat alles tot in de puntjes geregeld is.

The Job:
Een boeiende baan in een vooruitstrevend en informeel team binnen een van de grootste communicatiegroepen ter wereld. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen binnen een inspirerende werkomgeving. En natuurlijk mag je genieten van ons geweldige kantoor en fijne collega's die iedere werkdag weer bijzonder maken.

In dit dynamische team werk je samen met diverse bureaus om de leukste influencer campagnes op te zetten. Onze projecten zijn niet alleen gericht op de Nederlandse markt, maar beslaan heel West-Europa. In deze veelzijdige rol werk je nauw samen met leveranciers, influencers, interne collega’s en de grootste merken.

Taken en Verantwoordelijkheden:

• Je helpt bij het ontwikkelen van strategieën voor influencer marketingcampagnes.

• Je ondersteunt het team bij het identificeren en evalueren van geschikte influencers voor diverse merken en campagnes.

• Je zorgt dat influencers goed gebriefd worden en bewaakt de deadlines.

• Je zorgt dat de content in orde is en overlegt met de klant wanneer de content online kan.

• Je monitort de voortgang van campagnes en draagt zorg voor de rapportages.

• Je kijkt altijd hoe processen verbeterd en/of efficiënter uitgevoerd kunnen worden

title: Thermal Engineer

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops silicon and system-level solutions designed for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. The team is responsible for building the next generation of AI-native silicon while working closely with software and research partners to co-design hardware tightly integrated with AI models. In addition to delivering production-grade silicon for OpenAI’s supercomputing infrastructure, the team also creates custom design tools and methodologies that accelerate innovation and enable hardware optimized specifically for AI.

We are looking for an experienced Thermal Engineer with 7+ years of experience in thermal management of IT hardware from chip/package to system levels. You’ll work alongside experts in thermal, mechanical, electrical, software, and systems engineering to support the design, analysis, and validation of thermal solutions that ensure the reliability, efficiency, and longevity of mission-critical hardware. This position requires strong analytical skills, hands-on testing experience, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-disciplinary environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and optimize thermal solutions for data center hardware, including chips, power modules, and system-level cooling architectures

- Evaluate thermal performance at the chip, package, and board levels, addressing challenges related to power density, heat dissipation, and thermal interface materials

- Experience in chip/package-level thermal analysis, including die-level heat spreading, and package thermal modeling

- Ability to analyze experimental data, identify root causes of thermal issues, and implement corrective actions

- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform first-principles calculations to support design decisions.

- Self-driven, detail-oriented, and able to work independently or collaboratively in cross-functional engineering environments

- Extensive experience with data center hardware or high-performance computing systems at scale

- Practical experience in developing advanced cooling technologies

- Familiarity with thermal control algorithms and dynamic thermal management techniques

description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI - the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 - including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors - Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com .

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles . We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care . That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

• Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”

• Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world

• Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America

• Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Workato is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the ChatBots and AI team within our Platform organization. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity: you turn unclear requirements into clear execution plans, make confident decisions with incomplete information, and keep both the team and leadership aligned. The team is fully remote and international - you'll build the processes and culture that make it work at pace.

About the Team

The ChatBots and AI team's mission is to deliver AI agents to end users. We own the runtime and integration layer - conversation storage, API design, streaming, and integrations with external interfaces like Slack and other applications. The team is made up of Senior and Staff engineers working in Ruby/Rails and Go on a modern stack: PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, and AWS. You'll collaborate with dedicated QA, SRE, and UX/UI teams, as well as engineering teams across the broader organization. Workato has a strong cross-functional culture - your team won't work in isolation.

What You'll Do

Delivery

•
Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to scope projects, set timelines, and define what success looks like

•
Plan and track execution across quarters and sprints; deliver on schedule without compromising quality

•
Identify blockers early, resolve them decisively, and escalate when escalation is the right call

•
Balance feature work against internal investments - AI-SDLC, CI/CD, platform upgrades, and technical debt

Team

•
Manage, mentor, and grow a team of Senior and Staff engineers

•
Own hiring, onboarding, and performance management

•
Design team processes that fit a distributed, asynchronous environment - and evolve them as the team and company change

•
Apply AI tooling to how the team works, not just what it builds

Technical Ownership

•
Participate in architecture and design decisions as a technical peer to your engineers

•
Make trade-off calls on scope, approach, and sequencing - and be accountable for them

•
Understand the system deeply enough to allocate the team's capacity where it matters most

Communication

•
Keep leadership informed on progress, risks, and blockers with clarity and without spin

•
Build working relationships with peer leads across engineering and product

•
Represent your team's priorities and constraints i

title: Associate or Senior Water Resources Engineer
description:
Position Summary We are seeking an Associate or Senior Water Resources Engineer to help irrigation districts, groundwater sustainability agencies, and agricultural clients address some of California's most complex water management challenges. You will be part of a team with experienced professionals across many disciplines to develop innovative, practical solutions for water supply, long-term resource planning, groundwater sustainability, recharge projects, and infrastructure improvements. Depending on your experience, you will contribute to or lead projects from concept through completion while building meaningful relationships with clients throughout California's Central Valley and beyond.
What You'll Do Lead or support water resources planning, engineering, and implementation projects. Work directly with public agency and agricultural clients to understand needs and develop practical solutions. Prepare technical analyses, engineering reports, planning studies, grant applications, cost estimates, and design documents. Manage or support project scope, schedule, budget, and quality. Coordinate with engineers, hydrogeologists, planners, scientists, environmental professionals, surveyors, and construction managers. Participate in client meetings, field visits, and public meetings. Assist with client development activities. Mentor junior staff (senior-level candidates). Areas of Practice You may work on projects involving: Groundwater management and sustainability Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR) and Aquifer Storage & Recovery (ASR) Surface water conveyance and distribution systems Water conservation and sustainability planning Irrigation district operations and infrastructure Infrastructure repair, rehabilitation, and modernization Water rights, transfers, and exchanges Grant funding and project financing Environmental compliance Feasibility studies Public works infrastructure planning and design Qualifications: Required: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, or related engineering discipline. Active California Professional Engineer (PE) license, or PE licensure in another state with the ability to obtain California licensure within 18 months of hire. Experience contributing to engineering studies, investigations, planning efforts, or design projects. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams while building trusted client relationships. Ideal Associate-Level Candidate Typically 2+ years of relevant experience. Demonstrated technical capability and growing project responsibility. Interest in developing project management and client-facing skills. Preferred Experience Irrigation districts and agricultural water systems. California water rights and water management programs. Groundwater sustainability and recharge projects.
